# Spacedoc

> > A comprehensive health and medical resource by Dr. Duane Graveline exploring mitochondrial function, statin side effects, aging, and evidence-based treatment approaches.

Spacedoc is an educational health website featuring detailed articles on medical topics ranging from cancer treatment and hormone therapy to nutritional supplementation and aging. The site emphasizes the role of mitochondrial health, cellular energy metabolism, and the potential adverse effects of commonly prescribed medications like statins.

## Key Topics

- Statin side effects
- Mitochondrial health
- CoQ10 supplementation
- Cellular energy (ATP)
- Aging and nutrition
- Cholesterol metabolism
- Antioxidant therapy
- Cancer treatment
- Hormone replacement therapy
- Cardiovascular disease
- Drug safety
- Mitochondrial mutations
- Medical research
- Dr. Duane Graveline
- FDA regulation
